reason: A DeepSeek Harness Web plugin that lets users select chat text and insert it into the composer as a native reference for follow-up questions.

summaries.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness Web 中选中聊天文字即可将其作为引用插入输入框，便于针对原文继续提问。
summaries.en: Select text in a DeepSeek Harness Web chat and insert it into the composer as a native reference for follow-up questions.

capabilities: Reads selected text from chat messages
Inserts quoted text into the chat composer
Includes the full quoted text when the user sends a message
Adds a selectable quote action and preview chip to the web interface
